objective.statement: Design an extraction protocol for compound X from plant material maximizing yield within a 200 CNY budget.
objective.hypothesis: Yield of compound X increases with ethanol concentration up to 70% (v/v) then declines.

variables.name: ethanol_concentration
variables.operational_definition: Volume fraction of ethanol in the extraction solvent

variables.name: yield
variables.operational_definition: Mass of compound X extracted per gram of plant material

steps.action: Ultrasonic-assisted ethanol extraction of ground plant material

evidence.quote: highest extraction yield of compound X

steps.action: Filter extract through a 0.45 um membrane

evidence.quote: Filtration and measurement consume no extra reagent cost

steps.action: Measure compound X yield by spectrophotometry

evidence.quote: spectrophotometer for yield measurement has no model recorded

controls.purpose: Exclude solvent background signal from the yield reading
Verify detection sensitivity with a reference standard of compound X

optimizations.suggestion: Raise extraction temperature from 50 C to 55 C to shorten duration
optimizations.rationale: Higher temperature within the UB-200 limit increases diffusion rate while staying below the 60 C maximum; not yet pilot-verified.

risks.criterion: yield < 1 mg/g in the positive control
risks.alternative: re-check ethanol concentration and spectrophotometer calibration

confirmations.reason: no model recorded in the device manual; availability and spec unverified

uncertainty.reason: inferred from the device limit, not from pilot data

provenance.pipeline: actual material -> IR -> validate -> compute -> artifact -> result
